T: Fifty years of friendship, one very long dinner.
D: Four Lower East Side street kids grow into Prohibition gangsters, and one of them betrays the rest.
P: Bring the charlotte russe out when young Patsy sits on the stairs and eats the one he bought for Peggy.
S: hot mustard, Lower East Side street food
Mash potatoes with onion cooked low in schmaltz or butter, salt and white pepper. Wrap in rolled puff pastry, egg wash, bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Hot English mustard.
Lower East Side herring and rye bites
the Lower East Side streets where Noodles and the boys grow up

Pickled herring on buttered dark rye with sour cream, red onion, dill and a sliced dill pickle for crunch. Cut 6 slices dark rye into quarters and toast lightly. Butter each piece thinly. Drain 250g pickled herring fillets and cut into 24 bite-sized pieces. Mix 100g sour cream with 1 tsp lemon juice and a pinch of pepper. Spoon a little sour cream onto each toast, top with herring, a slice of dill pickle and a few rings of very thinly sliced red onion. Finish with chopped dill.
Slice day-old bagels thin, brush with oil, bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Whip cream cheese with chives and lemon zest, lox on the side.
M: slow braised with onions and gravy
Season brisket, sear hard, then braise at 150C on a bed of sliced onions with stock, tomato paste and paprika for 4 hours, covered. Rest, slice against the grain, reduce the juices to gravy.
eaten in the speakeasy back room
Steam sliced pastrami 10 minutes until soft and glistening. Pile high on seeded rye with yellow mustard. Full sour pickle on the side.
W: sponge, whipped cream and a cherry, try not to eat it on the stairs
Line paper cups with a disc of sponge, pipe whipped cream stabilised with a little mascarpone and vanilla high in a swirl, top with a maraschino cherry.
K: Fat Moe's rye whiskey sour in teacups
the speakeasy behind Fat Moe's, Prohibition in full swing

Rye whiskey shaken hard with lemon, sugar syrup and egg white, poured into china teacups with a few drops of bitters. Make sugar syrup by dissolving 50g caster sugar in 50ml hot water, then cool. Shake in two rounds: 120ml rye whiskey, 60ml lemon juice, 40ml sugar syrup and 1 egg white, first without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 china teacups. Add 2 drops of aromatic bitters to the foam on each and serve straight away.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead; reheat at 180C for 10 minutes

ingredients.item: salt and white pepper, to taste

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash.
Cook the onion in the butter over low heat until golden, then mix into the mash with salt and white pepper.
Cut each pastry sheet into 4 squares, fill, fold into parcels and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C until golden and puffed.
Serve with the hot mustard.

dishes.make_ahead: Crisps up to 2 days airtight; schmear up to 1 day chilled

steps.text: Slice the bagels into thin rounds and brush with olive oil.
Bake at 180C until crisp.
Beat the cream cheese with chives and lemon zest.
Serve the crisps with the schmear and smoked salmon on the side.

veg.n: Bagel crisps with schmear and cured beetroot
veg.make_ahead: Crisps up to 2 days airtight; schmear and beetroot up to 1 day chilled

steps.text: Peel the beetroot and slice it paper thin. Toss with the salt, sugar, dill and lemon juice and leave to cure for 30 minutes.
Slice the bagels into thin rounds and brush with olive oil.
Bake at 180C until crisp.
Beat the cream cheese with chives and lemon zest.
Serve the crisps with the schmear and the cured beetroot on the side.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 days ahead, slice cold and reheat in the gravy

steps.text: Season the brisket and sear hard on all sides.
Spread the onions in a roasting dish and sit the brisket on top. Pour over the stock whisked with tomato paste and paprika.
Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours.
Rest for 20 minutes, slice against the grain.
Boil the juices for 10 minutes to make gravy.

veg.n: Fat Moe's back room braised mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 days ahead and reheat in the gravy

steps.text: Season the mushrooms and sear hard in the oil on both sides.
Spread the onions in a roasting dish and sit the mushrooms on top. Pour over the stock whisked with tomato paste, paprika and soy sauce.
Cover and braise at 170C until the onions are jammy.
Lift out the mushrooms and slice thickly.
Boil the juices for 10 minutes to make gravy and pour over.
Cut 8 rounds of sponge to fit the bottom of the paper cups.
Whip the cream with mascarpone, icing sugar and vanilla to firm peaks.
Pipe high over the sponge in a tall swirl and top each with a cherry.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

dishes.n: Fat Moe's rye whiskey sour in teacups
dishes.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.
Shake the whiskey, lemon juice, 40ml of the syrup and egg white without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into four china teacups, dot the foam with bitters and serve straight away.

af.n: Fat Moe's rye whiskey sour in teacups (alcohol-free)
af.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and chill.
Shake 120ml of the tea, the lemon juice, 40ml of the syrup and egg white without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into four china teacups, dot the foam with drops of pomegranate molasses and serve straight away.

edition.tagline: Fifty years of friendship, one very long dinner.
edition.cue: Bring the charlotte russe out when young Patsy sits on the stairs and eats the one he bought for Peggy.

s.note: Buttery potato and slow-cooked onion baked in golden puff pastry.
s.how: Boil 500g peeled potatoes 15 minutes, drain and mash. Cook 1 finely diced brown onion in 30g butter over low heat for 15 minutes until golden, then mix into the mash with salt and white pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 4 squares each, fill, fold into parcels and brush with 1 beaten egg. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 40g hot English mustard.

s.note: Thin baked bagel crisps with chive cream cheese and smoked salmon.
s.how: Slice 3 day-old bagels into thin rounds, brush with 2 tbsp olive oil and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp. Beat 250g cream cheese with 2 tbsp chopped chives and the zest of 1 lemon. Serve the crisps with the schmear and 150g smoked salmon on the side.

m.note: Slow-braised brisket on sweet onions, sliced thick with rich gravy.
m.how: Season a 1.5kg beef brisket with salt and pepper and sear hard on all sides. Slice 3 brown onions into a roasting dish, sit the brisket on top, and pour over 500ml beef stock whisked with 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tsp sweet paprika. Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours. Rest 20 minutes, slice against the grain, and boil the juices for 10 minutes to make gravy.

w.note: Sponge cups piped high with vanilla cream and a cherry.
w.how: Cut 8 rounds from a 300g sponge cake to fit the bottom of 8 paper cups. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 100g mascarpone, 2 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla extract to firm peaks. Pipe high over the sponge in a tall swirl and top each with a maraschino cherry. Chill 30 minutes before serving.

Shake in two rounds: 120ml rye whiskey, 60ml lemon juice, 40ml sugar syrup and 1 egg white, first without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 china teacups. Add 2 drops of aromatic bitters to the foam on each and serve straight away.
